front_blocks.md: Define a **species** using the **biological species concept**.

back_blocks.md: A group of organisms with **similar morphology and physiology** that can **interbreed** to produce **fertile offspring**, and are **reproductively isolated** from other species.

cards.front_md: Define a **species** using the **biological species concept**.

front_blocks.md: Define the **morphological species concept**.

back_blocks.md: Organisms are classified as the same species based on their shared **physical features** (observable **morphology** and **anatomy**).

front_blocks.md: Define the **ecological species concept**.

back_blocks.md: A species is defined by the **ecological niche** it occupies — the role it plays in its environment.

front_blocks.md: Give one **limitation** of the **biological species concept**.

back_blocks.md: It **cannot** be applied to organisms that reproduce **asexually**, or to species known only from **fossils** (they cannot be tested for interbreeding).

front_blocks.md: Outline the characteristic features of the kingdom **Protoctista**.

back_blocks.md: **Eukaryotic**; mostly **single-celled** (or simple multicellular).
A diverse group of organisms that do **not** fit into Fungi, Plantae or Animalia; some are **autotrophic**, some **heterotrophic**.

front_blocks.md: Outline the characteristic features of the kingdom **Fungi**.

back_blocks.md: **Eukaryotic**; cell walls made of **chitin**.
**Heterotrophic** (saprotrophic — absorb nutrients); may be single-celled (yeast) or made of thread-like **hyphae**; store food as **glycogen**; reproduce by **spores**.

cards.front_md: Outline the characteristic features of the kingdom **Fungi**.

**Eukaryotic**; cell walls made of **chitin**.

**Heterotrophic** (saprotrophic — absorb nutrients); may be single-celled (yeast) or made of thread-like **hyphae**; store food as **glycogen**; reproduce by **spores**.

front_blocks.md: Outline the characteristic features of the kingdom **Plantae**.

back_blocks.md: **Eukaryotic** and **multicellular**; cell walls made of **cellulose**.
**Autotrophic** — contain **chlorophyll** and photosynthesise; store food as **starch**.

front_blocks.md: Outline the characteristic features of the kingdom **Animalia**.

back_blocks.md: **Eukaryotic** and **multicellular**; cells have **no cell wall**.
**Heterotrophic**; store carbohydrate as **glycogen**; usually show **nervous coordination**.
